# Importing data
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

nh4 <- read_excel("native_soil/Results/nh4_concentration_native.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(nh4) <- tolower(names(nh4))
nh4 <- nh4 %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, NH4 = 2)

no3 <- read_excel("native_soil/Results/no3_concentration_native.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(no3) <- tolower(names(no3))
no3 <- no3 %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, NO3 = 2)

bgluco <- read_excel("native_soil/Results/bglucosidase_activity_native.xlsx", col_types = c("text","numeric", "numeric"))
names(bgluco) <- tolower(names(bgluco))
bgluco <- bgluco %>% dplyr:: select(1, 3)
bgluco <- bgluco %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, Bglucosidase = 2)
bgluco <- bgluco %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, Bglucosidase = 2)

prot <- read_excel("native_soil/Results/protease_activity_native.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(prot) <- tolower(names(prot))
prot <- prot %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, Protease = 2)

des <- read_excel("native_soil/Results/desaminase_activity_native.xlsx", col_types = c("text", "numeric"))
names(des) <- tolower(names(des))
des <- des %>% dplyr::rename(sample = 1, Desaminase = 2)

# Merge everything
results <- nh4 %>%
full_join(no3,    by = "sample") %>%
full_join(bgluco, by = "sample") %>%
full_join(prot,   by = "sample") %>%
full_join(des,    by = "sample") %>%
arrange(sample)

# Replace negative data with 0
results$Bglucosidase[results$Bglucosidase < 0] <- 0
results$Protease[results$Protease < 0] <- 0
results$NO3[results$NO3 < 0] <- 0
results$NH4[results$NH4 < 0] <- 0
results$Desaminase[results$Desaminase < 0] <- 0
```


```{r}
# Add a "block" column with the prefix (ex:b1)
results$bloc <- sub("([a-z0-9]+)[a-z][0-9]+", "\\1", results$sample)

#  Add a "soil" column  (a = agricultural, f = forest)
results$soil <- ifelse(grepl("a", results$sample), "agricole", 
                  ifelse(grepl("f", results$sample), "forestier", NA))

#  Extract the last digit to know the dilution treatment 
results$treatment <- as.numeric(sub(".*([0-9])$", "\\1", results$sample))

# Add dilution treatment
treatment_map <- c("10^-8", "10^-6", "10^-4", "10^-2", "10^0", "0")
results$treatment <- treatment_map[results$treatment]
as.factor(results$treatment)

write_xlsx(results, path = "native_soil/Results/results_native_enzyme_nitrogen.xlsx")

agri <- results %>%
  filter(soil == "agricole")

forest <- results %>%
  filter(soil == "forestier")

```

#Crop soil
## Assumptions
### Outliers
```{r}
outlierammonium<- agri %>%
group_by(bloc) %>%
identify_outliers("NH4")

outliernitrate<- agri %>%
group_by(bloc) %>%
identify_outliers("NO3")


outlierprotease<- agri %>%
group_by(bloc) %>%
identify_outliers("Protease")
# b1a2 b3a2 b4a1

outlierbgluco<- agri %>%
group_by(bloc) %>%
identify_outliers("Bglucosidase")


outlierdes<- agri %>%
group_by(bloc) %>%
identify_outliers("Desaminase")

```

### Check for normality of residuals
```{r}

# nitrate
model<- lm(sqrt(NO3) ~ treatment, data = agri)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(model))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(model))
# p.value=0.118

#ammonium
modelamm<- lm( sqrt(NH4) ~ treatment, data = agri)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(modelamm))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modelamm))
# p.value=0.00882

#protease
modelprot<- lm( sqrt(Protease) ~ treatment, data = agri)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(modelprot))
#Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modelprot))
# p.value=0.000109

#deaminase
modeld<- lm( sqrt(Desaminase) ~ treatment, data = agri)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(modeld))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modeld))
# p.value= 0.438

#bglucosidase
modelbglu<- lm( Bglucosidase ~ treatment, data = agri)
# QQ plot
ggqqplot(residuals(modelbglu))
# Shapiro-Wilk
shapiro_test(residuals(modelbglu))
# p.value=0.0545
```

### Check for homogeneity of variances
```{r}
#NITRATE
bartlett.test(sqrt(agri$NO3), agri$treatment)
#p-value 0.7603

#AMMONIUM
bartlett.test(sqrt(agri$NH4), agri$treatment)
#p-value 0.754

#PROTEASE
bartlett.test(sqrt(agri$Protease), agri$treatment)
#p-value 2.2e-16

#BGLUCOSIDASE
bartlett.test(agri$Bglucosidase, agri$treatment)
#p-value 0.9784

#DESAMINASES
bartlett.test(sqrt(agri$Desaminase), agri$treatment)
#p-value  0.8534

```

## Kruskal-Wallis & ANOVA
```{r}

kw_protease.a <- kruskal.test(agri$Protease, agri$treatment)
#p-value = 0.1818
kw_protease.ablock <- kruskal.test(agri$Protease, agri$bloc)
#p-value = 0.09078

kw_ammonium.a <- kruskal.test(agri$NH4, agri$treatment)
#p-value = 0.5922
kw_ammonium.ablock <- kruskal.test(agri$NH4, agri$bloc)
#p-value = 0.7449

aovbglucoa <- aov(Bglucosidase ~ treatment+bloc, data=agri)
summary(aovbglucoa)
#            Df    Sum Sq   Mean Sq F value  Pr(>F)   
#treatment    5 1.419e-05 2.838e-06   1.102 0.39045   
#bloc         4 4.631e-05 1.158e-05   4.494 0.00941 **
#Residuals   20 5.152e-05 2.576e-06  

aovnita<- aov(sqrt(NO3) ~ treatment+bloc, data=agri)
summary(aovnita)
#            Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
#treatment    5 0.07911 0.015817   2.242 0.0899 .
#bloc         4 0.03118 0.007801   1.106 0.3812  
#Residuals   20 0.14108 0.007055  

aovdesa <- aov(sqrt(Desaminase) ~ treatment+bloc, data=agri)
summary(aovdesa)
#            Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5  10.64   2.128   1.362  0.280
#bloc         4  13.37   3.342   2.139  0.113
#Residuals   20  31.24   1.562
```

### Create dataframe
```{r}
kw_protease.a_df <- data.frame(
  variable  = "Protease",
  factor    = "treatment",
  test      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  statistic = kw_protease.a$statistic,
  df        = kw_protease.a$parameter,
  p         = kw_protease.a$p.value
)

kw_ammonium.a_df <- data.frame(
  variable  = "Ammonium",
  factor    = "treatment",
  test      = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  statistic = kw_ammonium.a$statistic,
  df        = kw_ammonium.a$parameter,
  p         = kw_ammonium.a$p.value
)

a.aov.nit_df <- broom::tidy(aovnita)
a.aov.des_df <- broom::tidy(aovdesa)
a.aov.bgluco_df <- broom::tidy(aovbglucoa)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "kw_protease
    _agricole" = kw_protease.a_df,
    "kw_ammonium_agricole" = kw_ammonium.a_df ,
    "Anova_nitrate_agricole" = a.aov.nit_df,
    "Anova_bglucosidase_agricole" = a.aov.bgluco_df,
    "Anova_desaminase_agricole" = a.aov.des_df
  ),
  path = here("native_soil/Results/native_crop_statistic.xlsx")
)
```

## Kruskal-Wallis & ANOVA
```{r}

#Forest
kw_protease.f <- kruskal.test(forest$Protease, forest$treatment)
#p-value = 0.3774
kw_protease.fbloc <- kruskal.test(forest$Protease, forest$bloc)
#p-value 0.01015

kw_ammonium.f <-kruskal.test(forest$NH4, forest$treatment)
#p-value = 0.003618

library(FSA)
dunnTest(NH4 ~ treatment, data = forest, method = "bh")

meannh4fo<-aggregate(NH4 ~ treatment, data = forest, mean)

diff4_0 <- (0.206163804/0.018298238)
diff6_0 <- (0.158941188/0.018298238)

kw_ammonium.fbloc <- kruskal.test(forest$NH4, forest$bloc)
#p-value = 0.2911

kw_nitrate.f <- kruskal.test(forest$NO3, forest$treatment)
#p-value = 0.7921
kw_nitrate.fbloc <- kruskal.test(forest$NO3, forest$bloc)
#p-value = 0.1499

aovbglucof <- aov(Bglucosidase ~ treatment+bloc, data=forest)
summary(aovbglucof)
#             Df    Sum Sq   Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
#treatment    5 1.262e-04 2.525e-05   2.903 0.0396 *
#bloc         4 6.371e-05 1.593e-05   1.831 0.1624  
#Residuals   20 1.740e-04 8.698e-06
TukeyHSD(aovbglucof)

kruskal.test(forest$Bglucosidase, forest$treatment)

aovdesf <- aov(sqrt(Desaminase) ~ treatment+bloc, data=forest)
summary(aovdesf)
#            Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
#treatment    5   6.34   1.268   1.014  0.435
#bloc         4  10.54   2.635   2.108  0.118
#Residuals   20  25.00   1.250  
```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)

# Color forest
couleurs <- c("10^0" = "#006D2C","10^-2" = "#31A354", "10^-4" = "#74C476","10^-6" = "#BAE4B3","10^-8" = "#EDF8E9", "0" = "grey80" )

forest$treatment <- factor(forest$treatment, levels = names(couleurs))

plotnitf <- ggplot(forest, aes(x=treatment, y=NO3, fill=treatment, colour=treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
  geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2) + 
  theme_classic() +

plotdesa <- ggplot(agri, aes(x=treatment, y=Desaminase, fill=treatment, colour=treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) + 
  geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.2) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(y="Nitrophenol deaminated (mg/g soil)", x=NULL) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = couleursa) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = couleursa) + 
  ggtitle("Deaminase activity") + scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "CTL", 
                              "10^-8" = "D8", 
                              "10^-6" = "D6",
                              "10^-4" = "D4", 
                              "10^-2" = "D2", 
                              "10^0" = "D0"))+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.background = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "gray95", size=0)) 

```


# plot together
```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)

max_prot <- max(c(agri$Protease, forest$Protease), na.rm = TRUE)
ylim_prot <- c(0, max_prot * 1.05)
plotprota <- plotprota + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_prot)
plotprotf <- plotprotf + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_prot)

max_bgluco <- max(c(agri$Bglucosidase, forest$Bglucosidase), na.rm = TRUE)
ylim_bgluco <- c(0, max_bgluco * 1.05)
plotbglucoa <- plotbglucoa + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_bgluco)
plotbglucof <- plotbglucof + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_bgluco)

max_des <- max(c(agri$Desaminase, forest$Desaminase), na.rm = TRUE)
ylim_des <- c(0, max_des * 1.05)
plotdesa <- plotdesa + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_des)
plotdesf <- plotdesf + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_des)


# Remove legends
plotprota <- plotprota + labs(fill = "Crop dilution", colour = "Crop dilution")
plotprotf <- plotprotf + labs(fill = "Forest dilution", colour = "Forest dilution")

plotprota   <- plotprota   + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotbglucoa <- plotbglucoa + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotdesa    <- plotdesa    + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotprotf   <- plotprotf   + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotbglucof <- plotbglucof + theme(legend.position = "none")
plotdesf    <- plotdesf    + theme(legend.position = "none")


# Get legend 1 crop soil
legend1 <- get_legend(
  plotprota +
    labs(fill = "Crop dilution", colour = "Crop dilution") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = couleursa,
                      labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                 "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                 "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = couleursa,
                       labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                  "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                  "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
)

# Get legend 2 forest soil
legend2 <- get_legend(
  plotprotf +
    labs(fill = "Forest dilution", colour = "Forest dilution") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = couleurs,
                      labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                 "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                 "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = couleurs,
                       labels = c("0" = "CTL", "10^-8" = "D8",
                                  "10^-6" = "D6", "10^-4" = "D4",
                                  "10^-2" = "D2", "10^0"  = "D0")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
)


ligne1 <- ggarrange(plotprota, plotbglucoa, plotdesa,
                    ncol = 3, labels = c("A","B","C"))
ligne2 <- ggarrange(plotprotf, plotbglucof, plotdesf,
                    ncol = 3, labels = c("D","E","F"))

#  Merge legends
legends <- plot_grid(legend1, legend2, ncol = 2)


figure_final <- plot_grid(
  ligne1,
  ligne2,
  legends,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.8, 0.2)
)


ggsave("native_soil/Figures/Fig_S3_Enzyme_native.tiff",plot=figure_final, dpi=600, compression="lzw",   width = 12.07,
  height = 10.01,
  units = "in")



```
